correctness.rationale: The complete 59049-state graph is enumerated via an explicitly specified adjacency and four-case successor rule, with a mathematically justified first-repeat/functional-graph classification. Three independently implemented exact programs agree: integer-memoized KG(5,2) census, tuple-by-tuple direct trajectory census, and pentagon–star presentation. The 120 maximally delayed configurations form two disjoint orbit sets of 60 each under the full S5 automorphism group, demonstrated by a group argument and enumeration of all 120 permutations. All 35 table cells, the period orbit counts, and the global map identity are checked.

value.rationale: Petersen is the canonical cubic girth-five graph and highly symmetric cage with overlapping 5-,6-,8- and 9-cycles. The exact joint period-by-first-entry census is a natural invariant of this wave-supporting non-tree network, beyond general circulation tests. The absence of primitive period 6 or 9 despite corresponding graph cycles, and the two complete symmetry classes of all maximally delayed states, are nontrivial structural information and useful finite benchmarks for classifying and checking excitable-media dynamics on overlapping-cycle networks.
